### Sorrow and Hope - Today's Insight - December 31, 2022
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-december-31-2022.html
Passage: 1 John 5:4
Points:
- Life brings profound suffering, loss, and trials that can shake human endurance.
- Secular philosophy offers no real hope beyond enduring grief and terminal misery.
- Christ meets believers in their hardships to provide sustaining grace and truth.
- Overcoming the world is an established certainty belonging to all who are born of God.
- Believers walk in victory by trusting God's sovereignty and daily grace through faith.

### Pleased with His Precepts
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/pleased-with-his-precepts
Passage: 1 John 5:3-5
Points:
- Being born of God transforms God's commandments from a heavy burden into a joy.
- The new birth overcomes worldly resistance by creating living faith within the believer.
- Faith in Christ removes innate hostility toward God's authority and will.
- Believers are liberated to embrace and delight in God's law from the heart.
